Are you physically strong and good at working in a team? Then this position in the cable department is perfect for you! 
 Over het werk 
As an employee in the cable department, you won't need a gym membership anymore. It's a varied job that involves a lot of physical work. 
Your workday starts at 10:00 AM. Your team leaders, Dora and Zsuzsa, will have already prepared the schedule of what needs to be done. It's a versatile position, but don't worry you'll be trained step by step so you can learn all the ins and outs of the job. 
Your tasks include order picking materials, measuring and cutting cables using different machines, operating the combi truck or stacker, and keeping the floor and your workspace tidy. There's very little computer work involved, apart from entering information into the system. 
It's important to follow the safety rules and not work too hastily to avoid mistakes as much as possible. You'll be working in a close-knit team that should feel like family. Everyone helps each other and works closely together. The main language spoken in this department is English, and people from different nationalities work here.
